sources.entry: autobahn-python - WebSocket & WAMP for Python on Twisted and asyncio.

summary.one_liner: Autobahn|Python is a library providing WebSocket and WAMP (Web Application Messaging Protocol) clients and servers for Python 3.11+, running on either Twisted or asyncio.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a WebSocket implementation (RFC 6455) with message, frame and streaming APIs, plus TLS (secure WebSocket) and proxy support. Adds a WAMP implementation with asynchronous remote procedure calls and publish/subscribe, which requires a separate WAMP router (the README names Crossbar.io as one option). The same application component code can run on Twisted or asyncio by changing the base class import. WebSocket per-message compression is supported via permessage-deflate, with optional brotli, bzip2 and snappy methods. WAMP serializers for JSON, MessagePack, CBOR and FlatBuffers are included by default, with UBJSON as an optional extra. Optional extras cover WAMP-cryptosign and WAMP-SCRAM authentication and an alpha SIMD acceleration library (NVX) for x86 CPUs.
use_cases: Build a real-time WebSocket server or client in Python
Send publish/subscribe events between Python services over WAMP
Expose remote procedures between applications using WAMP RPC
Run the same messaging component on Twisted or asyncio
Compress WebSocket messages with brotli or deflate
notable: Single codebase runs on both Twisted and asyncio with a one-line base-class change
Implements both WebSocket (RFC 6455) and WAMP RPC plus pub/sub on one connection
Claims 100% strict passes on the Autobahn Testsuite for conformance
Ships JSON, MessagePack, CBOR and FlatBuffers serializers by default
Targets CPython and PyPy with binary wheels across major platforms
caveats: Requires Python 3.11 or later; older Python versions need older release lines
WAMP needs a separate WAMP router such as Crossbar.io to route messages
NVX acceleration is marked alpha and requires an x86 CPU with SSE2
Snappy compression needs manual install and system libsnappy-dev, with no wheels
Docker images and PyInstaller packaging are no longer published or supported by the OSS project
keywords: send messages between browser and server
